title: Software upgrade v6.3, then v6.4
summary: Halt morocco-1 at height 23893261 for terpd v6.3.0, set for 10:00 UTC on Friday 2026-10-16. That binary copies application stores onto BLAKE3 trees and arms v6.4 at height 23893263. v6.4 switches keepers onto those trees. IBC stores stay SHA-256. Governance submits only v6.3. The full expedited deposit puts the proposal into a 24-hour vote; deposit it by 10:00 UTC on Thursday 2026-10-15 so the vote ends as the halt arrives.
